#Auto-generated load guard 13: puts HOB/HOC permanents into play to prove the
#engine can construct and resolve them. This catches the FATAL failure mode --
#an unrecognised phase/trigger name yields a null card and kills the engine in
#TestSuiteGame::initGame (Spell(observer, NULL)), as Beorn the Fierce did.
#Cards are referenced by id because many HOB/HOC names contain commas and the
#zone parser splits on commas.
#NOTE: the asserted counts are RECORDED CURRENT BEHAVIOUR, not verified-correct
#rules behaviour. This guards against crashes and silent card-load failure, not
#against a card doing the wrong thing.
#Covers: Eagles of the North, Elrond, Moon-Reader, Elven Chorus, Elven Passage, Elven Raft-Steerer, Elvenking's Halls
